title: Ɔyarefo a Onhinhim
intro: Wɔ nkɔmhyɛ abakɔsɛm mu no, nnipa kakraa bi na wɔde gyidi a enhinhim agyina adehwere a emu dɔ ne honam fam amanehunu a ɛte saa ano. Saa onipa yi asɛm no yɛ asuade a enni bere mu wɔ boasetɔ ne ahotoso a obi wɔ wɔ ɔsoro nyansa mu ho. Hena ne ɔkra yi?
clues: Allah na ɔpaw me sɛ memfa nkrasɛm bi mma, nanso me sɔhwɛ kɛse no amma ɛnam pow so, na mmom ɛnam ankorankoro amanehunu so.
Wogyee m’ahonyade, me mmoa ne me mma fii me nsam, mmiako mmiako.
Ná akuru akata me nipadua so, na ɛkaa me nkutoo gye mmoa a me hokafo de mae.
Mesu frɛɛ m’Awurade, gyee m’amanehunu toom na mehwehwɛɛ N’ammɔborɔhunu.
Wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ memfa me nan mmɔ fam, na asubura bi a ɛma ahoɔden puei.
Allah san de m’akwahosan bae na ɔmaa me abusua foforɔ ne ahonyadeɛ a ɛboro soɔ mpo sene kane no.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
